```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from utils.keys import get_key
import httpx

router = APIRouter()

from cerebras.cloud.sdk import Cerebras
import openai
import google.generativeai as genai

def cerebras_chat(model, messages):
    client = Cerebras(api_key=get_key("CEREBRAS_API_KEY"))
    return client.chat.completions.create(messages=messages, model=model)

def openai_chat(model, messages):
    openai.api_key = get_key("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    openai.organization = get_key("OPENAI_ORG_ID")
    return openai.ChatCompletion.create(model=model, messages=messages)

def google_gemini_chat(model, messages):
    genai.configure(api_key=get_key("GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY"))
    model = genai.GenerativeModel(model)
    return model.generate_content(messages)

PRIORITY_PROVIDERS = [
    "cerebras", "openai", "google"
]

MODEL_TABLE = {
    "qwen3-235b": ("cerebras", "qwen3-235b"),
    "qwen3-32b": ("cerebras", "qwen3-32b"),
    "llama-3.1-8b": ("cerebras", "llama3.1-8b"),
    "llama-3.3-70b": ("cerebras", "llama3.3-70b"),
    # stb, bővíthető...
}

@router.post("/chat")
async def chat(payload: dict):
    messages = payload.get("messages")
    model = payload.get("model", "qwen3-235b")
    prefer = payload.get("prefer", None)

    if not messages:
        raise HTTPException(400, "messages hiányzik")
    provider, model_id = MODEL_TABLE.get(model, ("cerebras", "qwen3-235b"))
    if prefer:
        provider = prefer

    try:
        if provider == "cerebras":
            resp = cerebras_chat(model_id, messages)
            return {"provider": "cerebras", "result": resp}
        elif provider == "openai":
            resp = openai_chat(model_id, messages)
            return {"provider": "openai", "result": resp}
        elif provider == "google":
            resp = google_gemini_chat(model_id, messages)
            return {"provider": "google", "result": resp}
        else:
            raise HTTPException(400, "nem támogatott provider")
    except Exception as e:
        # Failover másik providerre
        for fallback in PRIORITY_PROVIDERS:
            if fallback == provider:
                continue
            try:
                if fallback == "openai":
                    resp = openai_chat(model_id, messages)
                elif fallback == "cerebras":
                    resp = cerebras_chat(model_id, messages)
                elif fallback == "google":
                    resp = google_gemini_chat(model_id, messages)
                return {"provider": fallback, "result": resp}
            except Exception:
                continue
        raise HTTPException(500, f"Összes provider hiba: {str(e)}")

```

    model_obj = genai.GenerativeModel(model)
    resp = model_obj.generate_content(messages)
    return resp

PRIORITY_PROVIDERS = [
    "cerebras", "openai", "google"
]

MODEL_TABLE = {
    "qwen3-32b":         ("cerebras", "qwen3-32b"),
    "qwen3-235b":        ("cerebras", "qwen3-235b"),
    "llama-3.1-8b":      ("cerebras", "llama-3.1-8b"),
    "llama-3.3-70b":     ("cerebras", "llama-3.3-70b"),
    "llama-4-scout":     ("cerebras", "llama-4-scout"),
    "llama-4-maverick":  ("cerebras", "llama-4-maverick"),
    "deepseek-r1-llama-70b": ("cerebras", "deepseek-r1-llama-70b"),
    "gpt-4":             ("openai", "gpt-4"),
    "gpt-3.5-turbo":     ("openai", "gpt-3.5-turbo"),
    "gemini-pro":        ("google", "gemini-pro"),
}

@router.post("/chat")
async def chat(payload: dict):
    messages = payload.get("messages")
    model = payload.get("model", "qwen3-235b")
    prefer = payload.get("prefer", None)
    if not messages:
        raise HTTPException(400, "messages kötelező")
    provider, model_id = MODEL_TABLE.get(model, ("cerebras", "qwen3-235b"))
    if prefer:
        provider = prefer
    try:
        if provider == "cerebras":
            resp = cerebras_chat(model_id, messages)
            return {"provider": "cerebras", "result": resp}
        elif provider == "openai":
            resp = openai_chat(model_id, messages)
            return {"provider": "openai", "result": resp}
        elif provider == "google":
            resp = google_gemini_chat(model_id, messages)
            return {"provider": "google", "result": resp}
        else:
            raise HTTPException(400, "nem támogatott provider")
    except Exception as e:
        for fallback in PRIORITY_PROVIDERS:
            if fallback == provider:
                continue
            try:
                if fallback == "openai":
                    resp = openai_chat(model_id, messages)
                elif fallback == "cerebras":
                    resp = cerebras_chat(model_id, messages)
                elif fallback == "google":
                    resp = google_gemini_chat(model_id, messages)
                return {"provider": fallback, "result": resp}
            except Exception:
                continue
        raise HTTPException(500, f"Összes provider hiba: {str(e)}")

import time
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, AsyncGenerator
from loguru import logger
import orjson
from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential
import httpx
from datetime import datetime
import uuid

from .providers import CerebrasProvider, OpenAIProvider, GoogleProvider, AnthropicProvider
from .cache import CacheManager
from .exceptions import *

class LLMRouter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.providers = {
            "cerebras": CerebrasProvider(),
            "openai": OpenAIProvider(),
            "google": GoogleProvider(),
            "anthropic": AnthropicProvider()
        }
        self.priority_providers = ["cerebras", "openai", "google", "anthropic"]
        self.model_provider_map = {
            "qwen3-32b": "cerebras",
            "qwen3-235b": "cerebras",
            "llama-3.1-8b": "cerebras",
            "llama-3.3-70b": "cerebras", 
            "llama-4-scout": "cerebras",
            "llama-4-maverick": "cerebras",
            "deepseek-r1-llama-70b": "cerebras",
            "gpt-4o": "openai",
            "gpt-4o-mini": "openai",
            "gpt-3.5-turbo": "openai",
            "gemini-pro": "google",
            "gemini-pro-vision": "google",
            "claude-3-5-sonnet": "anthropic",
            "claude-3-opus": "anthropic"
        }
        self.circuit_breaker = {}
        self.batch_queue = {}
        
    async def route_request(
        self,
        request_type: str,
        request_data: Dict[str, Any],
        user_id: str,
        preferred_provider: Optional[str] = None,
        stream: bool = False
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        model = request_data.get("model", "qwen3-235b")
        primary_provider = preferred_provider or self.model_provider_map.get(model, "cerebras")
        
        # Circuit breaker ellenőrzés
        if self._is_circuit_open(primary_provider):
            primary_provider = self._get_fallback_provider(primary_provider)
            
        # Elsődleges provider próba
        try:
            response = await self._call_provider(
                primary_provider,
                request_type,
                request_data,
                user_id,
                stream
            )
            
            self._reset_circuit_breaker(primary_provider)
            return response
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Provider {primary_provider} failed: {str(e)}")
            self._increment_circuit_breaker(primary_provider)
            
            # Fallback provider chain
            for fallback_provider in self.priority_providers:
                if fallback_provider == primary_provider:
                    continue
                    
                if self._is_circuit_open(fallback_provider):
                    continue
                    
                try:
                    response = await self._call_provider(
                        fallback_provider,
                        request_type,
                        request_data,
                        user_id,
                        stream
                    )
                    
                    self._reset_circuit_breaker(fallback_provider)
                    logger.info(f"Fallback success with {fallback_provider}")
                    return response
                    
                except Exception as fallback_error:
                    logger.warning(f"Fallback {fallback_provider} failed: {str(fallback_error)}")
                    self._increment_circuit_breaker(fallback_provider)
                    continue
                    
            # Minden provider failed
            raise AllProvidersFailedException("Minden provider hibás")
    
    @retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=1, max=10))
    async def _call_provider(
        self,
        provider_name: str,
        request_type: str,
        request_data: Dict[str, Any],
        user_id: str,
        stream: bool = False
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        provider = self.providers.get(provider_name)
        if not provider:
            raise ProviderNotFoundException(f"Provider {provider_name} nem található")
            
        start_time = time.time()
        
        try:
            if request_type == "chat":
                response = await provider.chat_completion(request_data, stream=stream)
            elif request_type == "completion":
                response = await provider.completion(request_data, stream=stream)
            elif request_type == "embedding":
                response = await provider.embedding(request_data)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Nem támogatott request típus: {request_type}")
                
            # Response enrichment
            response["provider"] = provider_name
            response["processing_time"] = time.time() - start_time
            response["timestamp"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
            response["user_id"] = user_id
            
            return response
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Provider {provider_name} hiba: {str(e)}")
            raise ProviderCallException(f"Provider {provider_name} hívás sikertelen: {str(e)}")
    
    def _is_circuit_open(self, provider: str) -> bool:
        circuit_info = self.circuit_breaker.get(provider, {"failures": 0, "last_failure": 0})
        
        # Circuit open ha 5 vagy több hiba van 60 másodpercen belül
        if circuit_info["failures"] >= 5:
            if time.time() - circuit_info["last_failure"] < 60:
                return True
            else:
                # Reset circuit breaker
                self.circuit_breaker[provider] = {"failures": 0, "last_failure": 0}
                
        return False
    
    def _increment_circuit_breaker(self, provider: str):
        if provider not in self.circuit_breaker:
            self.circuit_breaker[provider] = {"failures": 0, "last_failure": 0}
            
        self.circuit_breaker[provider]["failures"] += 1
        self.circuit_breaker[provider]["last_failure"] = time.time()
        
    def _reset_circuit_breaker(self, provider: str):
        if provider in self.circuit_breaker:
            self.circuit_breaker[provider] = {"failures": 0, "last_failure": 0}
            
    def _get_fallback_provider(self, failed_provider: str) -> str:
        available_providers = [p for p in self.priority_providers if p != failed_provider]
        return available_providers[0] if available_providers else "cerebras"
    
    async def stream_response(self, response: Dict[str, Any]) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
        """Streaming response generátor"""
        if "stream" in response and response["stream"]:
            for chunk in response["stream"]:
                yield f"data: {orjson.dumps(chunk).decode()}\n\n"
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)  # Throttling
        else:
            yield f"data: {orjson.dumps(response).decode()}\n\n"
            
        yield "data: [DONE]\n\n"
    
    async def process_batch(self, batch_id: str, requests: List[Dict[str, Any]], user_id: str):
        """Batch feldolgozás"""
        self.batch_queue[batch_id] = {
            "status": "processing",
            "total": len(requests),
            "completed": 0,
            "failed": 0,
            "results": [],
            "started_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        }
        
        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(10)  # Max 10 concurrent requests
        
        async def process_single_request(request_data: Dict[str, Any], index: int):
            async with semaphore:
                try:
                    response = await self.route_request(
                        request_type=request_data.get("type", "chat"),
                        request_data=request_data,
                        user_id=user_id
                    )
                    
                    self.batch_queue[batch_id]["results"].append({
                        "index": index,
                        "success": True,
                        "response": response
                    })
                    self.batch_queue[batch_id]["completed"] += 1
                    
                except Exception as e:
                    self.batch_queue[batch_id]["results"].append({
                        "index": index,
                        "success": False,
                        "error": str(e)
                    })
                    self.batch_queue[batch_id]["failed"] += 1
        
        # Batch feldolgozás
        tasks = [
            process_single_request(req, i) 
            for i, req in enumerate(requests)
        ]
        
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        self.batch_queue[batch_id]["status"] = "completed"
        self.batch_queue[batch_id]["completed_at"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        
        logger.info(f"Batch {batch_id} feldolgozás befejezve")
    
    async def get_batch_status(self, batch_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Batch állapot lekérés"""
        if batch_id not in self.batch_queue:
            raise BatchNotFoundException(f"Batch {batch_id} nem található")
            
        return self.batch_queue[batch_id]
    
    async def get_provider_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Provider statisztikák"""
        stats = {}
        for provider_name, provider in self.providers.items():
            circuit_info = self.circuit_breaker.get(provider_name, {"failures": 0, "last_failure": 0})
            stats[provider_name] = {
                "available": not self._is_circuit_open(provider_name),
                "failures": circuit_info["failures"],
                "last_failure": circuit_info["last_failure"],
                "health": await provider.health_check() if hasattr(provider, 'health_check') else True
            }
        return stats

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import time
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List
import redis.asyncio as redis
from loguru import logger
import orjson
import os

class CacheManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.redis_url = os.getenv("REDIS_URL", "redis://localhost:6379/0")
        self.redis_client = None
        self.local_cache = {}
        self.cache_stats = {
            "hits": 0,
            "misses": 0,
            "sets": 0,
            "errors": 0
        }
        
    async def initialize(self):
        """Cache rendszer inicializálása"""
        try:
            self.redis_client = redis.from_url(
                self.redis_url,
                encoding="utf-8",
                decode_responses=False,
                max_connections=20
            )
            
            # Redis kapcsolat teszt
            await self.redis_client.ping()
            logger.info("✅ Redis cache sikeresen inicializálva")
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Redis cache inicializálás sikertelen: {str(e)}")
            logger.info("📦 Local cache fallback aktiválva")
            
    async def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Cache érték lekérése"""
        try:
            # Redis próba
            if self.redis_client:
                value = await self.redis_client.get(key)
                if value:
                    self.cache_stats["hits"] += 1
                    return value.decode() if isinstance(value, bytes) else value
            
            # Local cache fallback
            if key in self.local_cache:
                entry = self.local_cache[key]
                if entry["expires"] > time.time():
                    self.cache_stats["hits"] += 1
                    return entry["value"]
                else:
                    del self.local_cache[key]
            
            self.cache_stats["misses"] += 1
            return None
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Cache get hiba: {str(e)}")
            self.cache_stats["errors"] += 1
            return None
    
    async def set(self, key: str, value: str, expire: int = 3600):
        """Cache érték mentése"""
        try:
            # Redis próba
            if self.redis_client:
                await self.redis_client.setex(key, expire, value)
            
            # Local cache backup
            self.local_cache[key] = {
                "value": value,
                "expires": time.time() + expire
            }
            
            self.cache_stats["sets"] += 1
            
            # Local cache tisztítás (max 1000 item)
            if len(self.local_cache) > 1000:
                await self._cleanup_local_cache()
                
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Cache set hiba: {str(e)}")
            self.cache_stats["errors"] += 1
    
    async def delete(self, key: str):
        """Cache érték törlése"""
        try:
            if self.redis_client:
                await self.redis_client.delete(key)
            
            if key in self.local_cache:
                del self.local_cache[key]
                
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Cache delete hiba: {str(e)}")
    
    async def clear_all(self):
        """Teljes cache törlése"""
        try:
            if self.redis_client:
                await self.redis_client.flushdb()
            
            self.local_cache.clear()
            logger.info("🗑️ Cache sikeresen törölve")
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Cache clear hiba: {str(e)}")
    
    async def generate_cache_key(self, request_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """Cache kulcs generálása"""
        # Sensitive adatok kiszűrése
        filtered_data = {k: v for k, v in request_data.items() if k not in ["api_key", "auth_token"]}
        
        # Determinisztikus JSON string
        json_string = orjson.dumps(filtered_data, option=orjson.OPT_SORT_KEYS).decode()
        
        # SHA256 hash
        hash_object = hashlib.sha256(json_string.encode())
        return f"llm_cache:{hash_object.hexdigest()}"
    
    async def get_pattern_keys(self, pattern: str) -> List[str]:
        """Pattern alapú kulcs keresés"""
        try:
            if self.redis_client:
                keys = await self.redis_client.keys(pattern)
                return [key.decode() if isinstance(key, bytes) else key for key in keys]
            
            # Local cache pattern matching
            matching_keys = []
            for key in self.local_cache.keys():
                if self._match_pattern(key, pattern):
                    matching_keys.append(key)
            
            return matching_keys
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Pattern keys hiba: {str(e)}")
            return []
    
    async def get_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Cache statisztikák"""
        stats = dict(self.cache_stats)
        
        try:
            if self.redis_client:
                redis_info = await self.redis_client.info()
                stats["redis"] = {
                    "used_memory": redis_info.get("used_memory_human", "N/A"),
                    "connected_clients": redis_info.get("connected_clients", 0),
                    "total_commands_processed": redis_info.get("total_commands_processed", 0)
                }
            
            stats["local_cache_size"] = len(self.local_cache)
            stats["hit_rate"] = (stats["hits"] / max(stats["hits"] + stats["misses"], 1)) * 100
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Cache stats hiba: {str(e)}")
        
        return stats
    
    async def health_check(self) -> bool:
        """Cache health check"""
        try:
            if self.redis_client:
                await self.redis_client.ping()
                return True
            
            # Local cache mindig healthy
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Cache health check hiba: {str(e)}")
            return False
    
    async def _cleanup_local_cache(self):
        """Local cache tisztítás"""
        current_time = time.time()
        expired_keys = []
        
        for key, entry in self.local_cache.items():
            if entry["expires"] <= current_time:
                expired_keys.append(key)
        
        for key in expired_keys:
            del self.local_cache[key]
        
        # Ha még mindig túl sok van, töröljük a legrégebbieket
        if len(self.local_cache) > 800:
            sorted_items = sorted(
                self.local_cache.items(),
                key=lambda x: x[1]["expires"]
            )
            
            for key, _ in sorted_items[:200]:  # Töröljük az első 200-at
                del self.local_cache[key]
    
    def _match_pattern(self, key: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
        """Egyszerű pattern matching"""
        if "*" not in pattern:
            return key == pattern
        
        # Alapvető wildcard támogatás
        parts = pattern.split("*")
        if len(parts) == 2:
            return key.startswith(parts[0]) and key.endswith(parts[1])
        
        return False
    
    async def close(self):
        """Cache kapcsolat bezárása"""
        try:
            if self.redis_client:
                await self.redis_client.close()
            logger.info("🔒 Cache connection bezárva")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Cache close hiba: {str(e)}")

        """Teljesítmény percentilisek"""
        if not self.request_history:
            return {}
        
        durations = sorted([r.duration for r in self.request_history])
        length = len(durations)
        
        if length == 0:
            return {}
        
        return {
            "p50": durations[int(length * 0.5)],
            "p75": durations[int(length * 0.75)],
            "p90": durations[int(length * 0.9)],
            "p95": durations[int(length * 0.95)],
            "p99": durations[int(length * 0.99)]
        }
    
    async def _system_metrics_collector(self):
        """Rendszer metrikák gyűjtése háttérben"""
        while True:
            try:
                self.system_metrics = {
                    "cpu_percent": psutil.cpu_percent(interval=1),
                    "memory": psutil.virtual_memory()._asdict(),
                    "disk": psutil.disk_usage('/')._asdict(),
                    "network": psutil.net_io_counters()._asdict() if psutil.net_io_counters() else {},
                    "timestamp": time.time()
                }
                
                await asyncio.sleep(30)  # 30 másodpercenként
                
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"System metrics collection hiba: {str(e)}")
                await asyncio.sleep(60)
    
    async def _metrics_persistence(self):
        """Metrikák mentése fájlba"""
        while True:
            try:
                await asyncio.sleep(300)  # 5 percenként
                
                # Metrikák mentése
                summary = await self.get_summary()
                
                async with aiofiles.open(self.metrics_file, mode='a') as f:
                    await f.write(json.dumps({
                        "timestamp": time.time(),
                        "metrics": summary
                    }) + "\n")
                
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Metrics persistence hiba: {str(e)}")
                await asyncio.sleep(600)
    
    async def export_metrics(self, format: str = "json") -> str:
        """Metrikák exportálása"""
        if format == "json":
            return json.dumps(await self.get_detailed_stats(), indent=2)
        elif format == "csv":
            return self._export_csv()
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Nem támogatott formátum: {format}")
    
    def _export_csv(self) -> str:
        """CSV exportálás"""
        lines = ["timestamp,endpoint,method,status_code,duration,provider,model,tokens"]
        
        for metric in self.request_history:
            lines.append(f"{metric.timestamp},{metric.endpoint},{metric.method},{metric.status_code},{metric.duration},{metric.provider or ''},{metric.model or ''},{metric.tokens}")
        
        return "\n".join(lines)
    
    async def close(self):
        """Metrics collector bezárása"""
        logger.info("📊 Metrics Collector bezárása...")
        
        # Utolsó metrikák mentése
        try:
            summary = await self.get_summary()
            async with aiofiles.open(self.metrics_file, mode='a') as f:
                await f.write(json.dumps({
                    "timestamp": time.time(),
                    "final_metrics": summary,
                    "shutdown": True
                }) + "\n")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Final metrics save hiba: {str(e)}")

class AuthManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.secret_key = os.getenv("SECRET_KEY", "your-secret-key-here")
        self.algorithm = "HS256"
        self.token_expire_minutes = int(os.getenv("ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES", "30"))
        self.api_keys = {}
        self.load_api_keys()
        
    def load_api_keys(self):
        """API kulcsok betöltése"""
        # Alapértelmezett admin kulcs
        admin_key = os.getenv("ADMIN_API_KEY", "admin-key-12345")
        self.api_keys[admin_key] = {
            "user_id": "admin",
            "is_admin": True,
            "permissions": ["read", "write", "admin"],
            "rate_limit": 1000
        }
        
        # Demo kulcs
        demo_key = os.getenv("DEMO_API_KEY", "demo-key-67890")
        self.api_keys[demo_key] = {
            "user_id": "demo",
            "is_admin": False,
            "permissions": ["read"],
            "rate_limit": 100
        }
    
    async def authenticate(self, token: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Token authentikáció"""
        try:
            # JWT token ellenőrzés
            if token.startswith("jwt:"):
                return await self._validate_jwt_token(token[4:])
            
            # API key ellenőrzés
            if token in self.api_keys:
                return self.api_keys[token]
            
            # Bearer token ellenőrzés
            if token.startswith("Bearer "):
                api_key = token[7:]
                if api_key in self.api_keys:
                    return self.api_keys[api_key]
            
            return None
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Authentication hiba: {str(e)}")
            return None
    
    async def _validate_jwt_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """JWT token validálás"""
        try:
            payload = jwt.decode(token, self.secret_key, algorithms=[self.algorithm])
            
            # Lejárat ellenőrzés
            if payload.get("exp", 0) < time.time():
                return None
            
            return {
                "user_id": payload.get("user_id"),
                "is_admin": payload.get("is_admin", False),
                "permissions": payload.get("permissions", ["read"]),
                "rate_limit": payload.get("rate_limit", 100)
            }
            
        except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
            logger.warning("JWT token lejárt")
            return None
        except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
            logger.warning("Érvénytelen JWT token")
            return None
    
    async def create_jwt_token(self, user_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """JWT token létrehozása"""
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=self.token_expire_minutes)
        
        payload = {
            "user_id": user_data["user_id"],
            "is_admin": user_data.get("is_admin", False),
            "permissions": user_data.get("permissions", ["read"]),
            "rate_limit": user_data.get("rate_limit", 100),
            "exp": expire.timestamp(),
            "iat": time.time()
        }
        
        return jwt.encode(payload, self.secret_key, algorithm=self.algorithm)
    
    async def hash_password(self, password: str) -> str:
        """Jelszó hash-elés"""
        return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode()
    
    async def verify_password(self, password: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
        """Jelszó ellenőrzés"""
        return bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode(), hashed.encode())
    
    async def generate_api_key(self, user_id: str, permissions: list = None) -> str:
        """API kulcs generálása"""
        if permissions is None:
            permissions = ["read"]
        
        # Egyedi API kulcs generálása
        timestamp = str(int(time.time()))
        unique_string = f"{user_id}_{timestamp}_{self.secret_key}"
        api_key = hashlib.sha256(unique_string.encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
        
        # API kulcs mentése
        self.api_keys[api_key] = {
            "user_id": user_id,
            "is_admin": "admin" in permissions,
            "permissions": permissions,
            "rate_limit": 500,
            "created_at": timestamp
        }
        
        return api_key
    
    async def revoke_api_key(self, api_key: str) -> bool:
        """API kulcs visszavonása"""
        if api_key in self.api_keys:
            del self.api_keys[api_key]
            return True
        return False
    
    async def get_user_permissions(self, user_id: str) -> list:
        """Felhasználó jogosultságainak lekérése"""
        for api_key, data in self.api_keys.items():
            if data["user_id"] == user_id:
                return data["permissions"]
        return []
    
    async def check_permission(self, user_data: Dict[str, Any], required_permission: str) -> bool:
        """Jogosultság ellenőrzés"""
        permissions = user_data.get("permissions", [])
        return required_permission in permissions or "admin" in permissions
    
    def create_secure_hash(self, data: str) -> str:
        """Biztonságos hash létrehozása"""
        return hmac.new(
            self.secret_key.encode(),
            data.encode(),
            hashlib.sha256
        ).hexdigest()
    
    def verify_secure_hash(self, data: str, hash_value: str) -> bool:
        """Biztonságos hash ellenőrzés"""
        expected_hash = self.create_secure_hash(data)
        return hmac.compare_digest(expected_hash, hash_value)

        max_tokens = request_data["max_tokens"]
        if max_tokens > 131072:
            errors.append(f"Max tokens túl nagy: {max_tokens} (limit: 131072)")
        elif max_tokens > 32768:
            warnings.append(f"Nagy token limit: {max_tokens}")
    
    # Temperature validálás
    if "temperature" in request_data:
        temperature = request_data["temperature"]
        if not 0.0 <= temperature <= 2.0:
            errors.append(f"Temperature tartományon kívül: {temperature} (0.0-2.0)")
    
    # Messages validálás
    if "messages" in request_data:
        messages = request_data["messages"]
        if not isinstance(messages, list) or len(messages) == 0:

            errors.append(f"Túl sok üzenet: {len(messages)} (limit: 100)")
        
        # Üzenet struktúra ellenőrzés
        for i, message in enumerate(messages):
            if not isinstance(message, dict):
                errors.append(f"Üzenet {i} nem dictionary")
                continue
                
            if "role" not in message:
                errors.append(f"Üzenet {i} role hiányzik")
            elif message["role"] not in ["system", "user", "assistant"]:
                errors.append(f"Üzenet {i} érvénytelen role: {message['role']}")
                
            if "content" not in message:
                errors.append(f"Üzenet {i} content hiányzik")
            elif not isinstance(message["content"], str):
                errors.append(f"Üzenet {i} content nem string")
            elif len(message["content"]) > 100000:
                errors.append(f"Üzenet {i} content túl hosszú: {len(message['content'])}")
    
    return {
        "valid": len(errors) == 0,
        "errors": errors,
        "warnings": warnings
    }

    async def cerebras_chat(self, model: str, messages: List[Dict], stream: bool = False, **kwargs):

        try:

                response = self.cerebras_client.chat.completions.create(

                )
                async for chunk in response:
                    yield chunk
            else:
                response = self.cerebras_client.chat.completions.create(

                )
                return response
        except Exception as e:
            self.provider_health["cerebras"] = False
            raise Exception(f"Cerebras error: {str(e)}")

    async def openai_chat(self, model: str, messages: List[Dict], stream: bool = False, **kwargs):
        """OpenAI chat implementation"""
        try:
            if stream:
                response = self.openai_client.chat.completions.create(
                    model=model, messages=messages, stream=True, **kwargs
                )

                )

        except Exception as e:

            raise Exception(f"OpenAI error: {str(e)}")

    async def google_chat(self, model: str, messages: List[Dict], stream: bool = False, **kwargs):
        """Google/Gemini chat implementation"""
        try:
            model_obj = genai.GenerativeModel(model)
            # Convert messages to Google format
            content = "\n".join([f"{msg['role']}: {msg['content']}" for msg in messages])
            
            if stream:
                response = model_obj.generate_content(content, stream=True, **kwargs)
                for chunk in response:

            else:
                response = model_obj.generate_content(content, **kwargs)

        except Exception as e:
            self.provider_health["google"] = False
            raise Exception(f"Google error: {str(e)}")

    async def chat(self, messages: List[Dict], model: str = "qwen3-235b", stream: bool = False, **kwargs):
        """Main chat method with provider failover"""
        provider, model_id = self.MODEL_MAPPINGS.get(model, ("cerebras", "qwen3-235b"))
        
        # Try primary provider first
        for attempt_provider in [provider] + [p for p in self.PRIORITY_PROVIDERS if p != provider]:
            if not self.provider_health.get(attempt_provider, False):
                continue
                
            try:
                if attempt_provider == "cerebras":
                    result = self.cerebras_chat(model_id, messages, stream, **kwargs)
                elif attempt_provider == "openai":
                    result = self.openai_chat(model_id, messages, stream, **kwargs)
                elif attempt_provider == "google":
                    result = self.google_chat(model_id, messages, stream, **kwargs)
                elif attempt_provider == "perplexity":
                    result = self.perplexity_chat(model_id, messages, stream, **kwargs)
                
                if stream:
                    async for chunk in result:
                        yield {"provider": attempt_provider, "model": model_id, "chunk": chunk}
                else:
                    response = await result if asyncio.iscoroutine(result) else result
                    return {"provider": attempt_provider, "model": model_id, "result": response}
                    
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Provider {attempt_provider} failed: {str(e)}")
                continue
        
        raise Exception("All providers failed")

class VectorManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.embedding_model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
        
    def generate_embedding(self, text: str) -> List[float]:
        """Generate embedding for text"""
        embedding = self.embedding_model.encode(text)
        return embedding.tolist()
    
    def store_document(self, user_id: int, filename: str, content: str, metadata: Dict = None):
        """Store document with embedding"""
        try:
            embedding = self.generate_embedding(content)
            
            db = get_db()
            cursor = db.cursor()
            cursor.execute('''
                INSERT INTO documents (user_id, filename, content, embedding, metadata)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ''', (user_id, filename, content, json.dumps(embedding), json.dumps(metadata or {})))
            db.commit()
            doc_id = cursor.lastrowid
            db.close()
            
            return doc_id
        except Exception as e:
            raise Exception(f"Document storage failed: {str(e)}")
    
    def search_documents(self, user_id: int, query: str, top_k: int = 5) -> List[Dict]:
        """Search documents using embedding similarity"""
        try:
            query_embedding = self.generate_embedding(query)
            
            db = get_db()
            cursor = db.cursor()
            cursor.execute('''
                SELECT id, filename, content, embedding, metadata
                FROM documents WHERE user_id = ?
            ''', (user_id,))
            
            documents = cursor.fetchall()
            db.close()
            
            # Calculate similarities
            results = []
            for doc in documents:
                doc_embedding = json.loads(doc['embedding'])
                similarity = np.dot(query_embedding, doc_embedding) / (
                    np.linalg.norm(query_embedding) * np.linalg.norm(doc_embedding)
                )
                
                results.append({
                    'id': doc['id'],
                    'filename': doc['filename'],
                    'content': doc['content'],
                    'similarity': similarity,
                    'metadata': json.loads(doc['metadata'])
                })
            
            # Sort by similarity and return top_k
            results.sort(key=lambda x: x['similarity'], reverse=True)
            return results[:top_k]
            
        except Exception as e:
            raise Exception(f"Document search failed: {str(e)}")

        if "tavily" in sources:
            tasks.append(self.search_tavily(query, max_results))
        
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        # Combine results
        all_results = []
        for result in results:
            if isinstance(result, list):
                all_results.extend(result)
        
        # Remove duplicates by URL
        unique_results = {}
        for result in all_results:
            url = result.get("url", "")
            if url and url not in unique_results:
                unique_results[url] = result
        
        # Sort by score
        final_results = list(unique_results.values())
        final_results.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("score", 0), reverse=True)
        
        return final_results[:max_results]

class ConnectionManager:

        self.active_connections: Dict[str, WebSocket] = {}

    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, client_id: str):
        await websocket.accept()
        self.active_connections[client_id] = websocket

    def disconnect(self, client_id: str):
        if client_id in self.active_connections:
            del self.active_connections[client_id]

    async def send_personal_message(self, message: str, websocket: WebSocket):
        await websocket.send_text(message)

    async def broadcast(self, message: str):
        for connection in self.active_connections.values():
            await connection.send_text(message)

@app.post("/llm/chat")
async def chat(request: ChatRequest, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """Advanced chat with provider failover"""
    try:
        # Store session
        session_id = f"session_{current_user['id']}_{int(time.time())}"
        
        if request.stream:
            async def stream_generator():
                total_tokens = 0
                async for chunk in provider_manager.chat(
                    messages=request.messages,
                    model=request.model,
                    stream=True,
                    temperature=request.temperature,
                    max_tokens=request.max_tokens
                ):
                    if chunk.get('chunk'):
                        total_tokens += 1
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps(chunk)}\n\n"
                
                # Save session
                db = get_db()
                cursor = db.cursor()
                cursor.execute('''
                    INSERT INTO chat_sessions (user_id, session_id, model, messages, tokens_used, cost)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ''', (current_user['id'], session_id, request.model, json.dumps(request.messages), total_tokens, total_tokens * 0.0001))
                db.commit()
                db.close()
                
                yield "data: [DONE]\n\n"
            
            return StreamingResponse(stream_generator(), media_type="text/plain")
        else:
            response = await provider_manager.chat(
                messages=request.messages,
                model=request.model,
                temperature=request.temperature,
                max_tokens=request.max_tokens
            )
            
            # Calculate tokens (simplified)
            tokens_used = len(str(response).split())
            cost = tokens_used * 0.0001
            
            # Save session
            db = get_db()
            cursor = db.cursor()
            cursor.execute('''
                INSERT INTO chat_sessions (user_id, session_id, model, provider, messages, tokens_used, cost)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ''', (current_user['id'], session_id, request.model, response['provider'], json.dumps(request.messages), tokens_used, cost))
            db.commit()
            db.close()
            
            return {
                "provider": response["provider"],
                "model": response["model"],
                "result": response["result"],
                "session_id": session_id,
                "tokens_used": tokens_used,
                "cost": cost
            }
    
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Chat failed: {str(e)}")

@app.websocket("/ws/{client_id}")
async def websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket, client_id: str):
    """WebSocket endpoint for real-time communication"""
    await connection_manager.connect(websocket, client_id)
    try:
        while True:
            data = await websocket.receive_text()
            message = json.loads(data)
            
            if message.get("type") == "chat":
                # Handle real-time chat
                async for chunk in provider_manager.chat(
                    messages=message.get("messages", []),
                    model=message.get("model", "qwen3-235b"),
                    stream=True
                ):
                    await connection_manager.send_personal_message(
                        json.dumps({"type": "chat_chunk", "data": chunk}),
                        websocket
                    )
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        connection_manager.disconnect(client_id)

## backend.py ```python """ Ultimate LLM Engine – single-file backend API-first, Cerebras-prioritású több-provider motor, RAG, webkeresés, JWT-auth. Környezeti változók (.env): a korábban felsorolt API-kulcsok KÖTELEZŐK. Futtatás: uvicorn backend:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7860 """ import os, json, time, secrets, string, sqlite3, asyncio, hashlib from datetime import datetime, timedelta from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, AsyncGenerator from contextlib import asynccontextmanager from fastapi import ( FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, UploadFile, File, BackgroundTasks ) from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, OAuth2PasswordRequestForm from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse, FileResponse from pydantic import BaseModel from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings from passlib.context import CryptContext from jose import jwt, JWTError import httpx, numpy as np from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer from cerebras_cloud import Cerebras import openai, google.generativeai as genai from dotenv import load_dotenv # ─────────────────────── CONFIG ─────────────────────── load_dotenv(".env") class Settings(BaseSettings): EXA_API_KEY: str OPENAI_API_KEY: str OPENAI_ORG_ID: str OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY: str GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY: str GEMINI_API_KEY: str GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY: str CEREBRAS_API_KEY: str ALPHAGENOME_API_KEY: str GITHUB_TOKEN: str JINA_AI_API_KEY: str PINECONE_API_KEY: str PERPLEXITY_API_KEY: str VESPA_API_KEY: str BRAVE_API_KEY: str TAVILY_API_KEY: str PORTKEY_API_KEY: str PORTKEY_VIRTUAL_KEY: str SECRET_KEY: str = "change-me" ALGORITHM: str = "HS256" TOKEN_EXP_MIN: int = 30 DB_PATH: str = "ultimate_llm.db" class Config: env_file = ".env" settings = Settings() # ─────────────────── SECURITY / AUTH ─────────────────── pwd_ctx = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto") bearer = HTTPBearer() def hash_pwd(p: str) -> str: return pwd_ctx.hash(p) def verify_pwd(p: str, h: str) -> bool: return pwd_ctx.verify(p, h) def jwt_encode(data, exp_min=None): payload = data.copy() payload["exp"] = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=exp_min or settings.TOKEN_EXP_MIN) return jwt.encode(payload, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithm=settings.ALGORITHM) def jwt_decode(token): return jwt.decode(token, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[settings.ALGORITHM]) # ───────────────────── DATABASE ───────────────────── def init_db(): con = sqlite3.connect(settings.DB_PATH); cur = con.cursor() cur.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT UNIQUE, email TEXT UNIQUE, pwd TEXT, admin INT DEFAULT 0, active INT DEFAULT 1, api_key TEXT UNIQUE, created TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)""") cur.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, sid TEXT, model TEXT, provider TEXT, msgs TEXT, tokens INT, cost REAL, created TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)""") cur.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS docs( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, name TEXT, content TEXT, embed TEXT, meta TEXT, created TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)""") con.commit(); con.close() def db(): # context helper con = sqlite3.connect(settings.DB_PATH) con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row try: yield con finally: con.close() # ───────────────────── PROVIDERS ───────────────────── openai.api_key, openai.organization = settings.OPENAI_API_KEY, settings.OPENAI_ORG_ID genai.configure(api_key=settings.GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY) cb_client = Cerebras(api_key=settings.CEREBRAS_API_KEY) embedding_model = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2") MODEL_MAP = { "qwen3-32b": ("cerebras", "qwen3-32b"), "qwen3-235b": ("cerebras", "qwen3-235b"), "llama-3.1-8b": ("cerebras", "llama-3.1-8b"), "llama-3.3-70b": ("cerebras", "llama-3.3-70b"), "llama-4-scout": ("cerebras", "llama-4-scout"), "llama-4-maverick": ("cerebras", "llama-4-maverick"), "deepseek-r1-llama-70b": ("cerebras", "deepseek-r1-llama-70b"), "gpt-4": ("openai", "gpt-4"), "gpt-3.5-turbo": ("openai", "gpt-3.5-turbo"), "gemini-pro": ("google", "gemini-pro") } PROVIDERS = ["cerebras", "openai", "google", "perplexity"] async def call_provider(provider, model, msgs, stream=False, **kw): if provider == "cerebras": if stream: res = cb_client.chat.completions.create(model=model, messages=msgs, stream=True, **kw) async for c in res: yield c else: return cb_client.chat.completions.create(model=model, messages=msgs, **kw) elif provider == "openai": if stream: res = openai.ChatCompletion.create(model=model, messages=msgs, stream=True, **kw) for c in res: yield c else: return openai.ChatCompletion.create(model=model, messages=msgs, **kw) elif provider == "google": content = "\n".join(f"{m['role']}: {m['content']}" for m in msgs) m = genai.GenerativeModel(model) if stream: for c in m.generate_content(content, stream=True, **kw): yield c else: return m.generate_content(content, **kw) else: # perplexity simple call async with httpx.AsyncClient() as cli: r = await cli.post("", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.PERPLEXITY_API_KEY}"}, json={"model": model, "messages": msgs, "stream": stream, **kw}) return r.json() # ───────────────────── HELPERS ───────────────────── def gen_api_key(): return ''.join(secrets.choice(string.ascii_letters+string.digits) for _ in range(32)) def embedding(text): return embedding_model.encode(text).tolist() def cosine(a,b): return float(np.dot(a,b)/(np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(b))) # ───────────────────── FASTAPI APP ───────────────────── @asynccontextmanager async def life(app: FastAPI): init_db() # ensure default admin with next(db()) as con: cur = con.cursor() cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username='admin'") if not cur.fetchone(): cur.execute("INSERT INTO users(username,email,pwd,admin,api_key) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", ("admin","admin@local",hash_pwd("admin123"),1,gen_api_key())) con.commit() yield app = FastAPI(title="Ultimate LLM Engine", version="4.0", lifespan=life) app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["*"], allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"]) app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=1000) # ───────────────────── SCHEMAS ───────────────────── class SignUp(BaseModel): username:str; email:str; password:str class Token(BaseModel): access_token:str; token_type:str="bearer" class ChatReq(BaseModel): messages: List[Dict[str,str]] model:str="qwen3-235b"; stream:bool=False temperature:float=0.7; max_tokens:int=4000 class RAGReq(BaseModel): query:str; model:str="qwen3-235b"; top_k:int=5 # ───────────────────── AUTH DEPS ───────────────────── def user_dep(token:HTTPAuthorizationCredentials=Depends(bearer)): try: payload=jwt_decode(token.credentials) uname=payload.get("sub"); assert uname except Exception: raise HTTPException(401,"Invalid token") with next(db()) as con: cur=con.cursor(); cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=?", (uname,)) u=cur.fetchone() if not u or not u["active"]: raise HTTPException(401,"Inactive user") return dict(u) # ───────────────────── AUTH ROUTES ───────────────────── @app.post("/auth/register", response_model=Token) def register(body:SignUp): with next(db()) as con: cur=con.cursor() if cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username=?",(body.username,)).fetchone(): raise HTTPException(400,"Username taken") cur.execute("INSERT INTO users(username,email,pwd,api_key) VALUES(?,?,?,?)", (body.username,body.email,hash_pwd(body.password),gen_api_key())) con.commit() return login(OAuth2PasswordRequestForm(username=body.username,password=body.password,scope="")) @app.post("/auth/login", response_model=Token) def login(form_data:OAuth2PasswordRequestForm=Depends()): with next(db()) as con: cur=con.cursor(); cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=?", (form_data.username,)) u=cur.fetchone() if not u or not verify_pwd(form_data.password,u["pwd"]): raise HTTPException(401,"Bad credentials") return {"access_token":jwt_encode({"sub":u["username"]}),"token_type":"bearer"} # ───────────────────── CHAT ───────────────────── @app.post("/llm/chat") async def chat(req:ChatReq, user=Depends(user_dep)): prov, model_id = MODEL_MAP.get(req.model, ("cerebras","qwen3-235b")) sid = f"{user['id']}_{int(time.time())}" if req.stream: async def gen(): tokens=0 async for ch in call_provider(prov,model_id,req.messages,stream=True,temperature=req.temperature,max_tokens=req.max_tokens): tokens+=1 yield f"data:{json.dumps(ch)}\n\n" with next(db()) as con: con.execute("INSERT INTO sessions(user_id,sid,model,provider,msgs,tokens,cost) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (user["id"],sid,req.model,prov,json.dumps(req.messages),tokens,tokens*0.0001)); con.commit() yield "data:[DONE]\n\n" return StreamingResponse(gen(),media_type="text/plain") else: res = await call_provider(prov,model_id,req.messages,temperature=req.temperature,max_tokens=req.max_tokens) tokens=len(str(res).split()) with next(db()) as con: con.execute("INSERT INTO sessions(user_id,sid,model,provider,msgs,tokens,cost) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (user["id"],sid,req.model,prov,json.dumps(req.messages),tokens,tokens*0.0001)); con.commit() return {"provider":prov,"model":req.model,"result":res,"session_id":sid,"tokens":tokens} # ───────────────────── DOCUMENTS / RAG ───────────────────── @app.post("/rag/upload") async def upload(file:UploadFile=File(...), user=Depends(user_dep)): txt = (await file.read()).decode() emb = json.dumps(embedding(txt)) with next(db()) as con: cur=con.cursor() cur.execute("INSERT INTO docs(user_id,name,content,embed,meta) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", (user["id"],file.filename,txt,emb,json.dumps({"type":file.content_type}))) con.commit(); doc_id=cur.lastrowid return {"doc_id":doc_id,"status":"stored"} @app.post("/rag/query") async def rag(req:RAGReq, user=Depends(user_dep)): q_emb = embedding(req.query) with next(db()) as con: cur=con.cursor(); cur.execute("SELECT id,name,content,embed FROM docs WHERE user_id=?", (user["id"],)) docs=[] for d in cur.fetchall(): sim=cosine(q_emb,json.loads(d["embed"])) docs.append((sim,d)) docs.sort(reverse=True,key=lambda x:x[0]); top=docs[:req.top_k] ctxt="\n\n".join(f"Doc{i+1}:{d[1]['content'][:500]}" for i,d in enumerate(top)) msgs=[{"role":"system","content":f"Use context:\n{ctxt}"},{"role":"user","content":req.query}] resp=await call_provider(*MODEL_MAP.get(req.model),msgs) return {"answer":str(resp),"sources":[{"id":d[1]["id"],"score":d[0]} for d in top]} # ───────────────────── SEARCH ───────────────────── async def exa(q,n): import exa_py; e=exa_py.Exa(api_key=settings.EXA_API_KEY) r=e.search(query=q,num_results=n,include_content=True) return [{"url":x.url,"title":x.title,"snippet":x.content[:160]} for x in r.results] async def brave(q,n): async with httpx.AsyncClient() as c: r=await c.get("", headers={"X-Subscription-Token":settings.BRAVE_API_KEY},params={"q":q,"count":n}) if r.status_code!=200: return [] return [{"url":x["url"],"title":x["title"],"snippet":x["description"]} for x in r.json().get("web",{}).get("results",[])] async def tavily(q,n): async with httpx.AsyncClient() as c: r=await c.post("",json={"api_key":settings.TAVILY_API_KEY,"query":q,"max_results":n,"include_content":True}) if r.status_code!=200:return [] return [{"url":x["url"],"title":x["title"],"snippet":x["content"][:160]} for x in r.json().get("results",[])] @app.get("/search") async def web(q:str, n:int=10, user=Depends(user_dep)): res=await asyncio.gather(exa(q,n),brave(q,n),tavily(q,n)) seen,final=[],[] for lst in res: for r in lst: if r["url"] not in seen: seen.append(r["url"]); final.append(r) return {"total":len(final),"results":final[:n]} # ───────────────────── STATIC FRONTEND ───────────────────── @app.get("/app", response_class=FileResponse) def app_file(): return FileResponse("frontend.html", media_type="text/html") # ───────────────────── WEBSOCKET ───────────────────── class ConnMgr: conns:dict={} mgr=ConnMgr() @app.websocket("/ws/{cid}") async def ws(ws:WebSocket,cid:str): await ws.accept(); mgr.conns[cid]=ws try: while True: data=json.loads(await ws.receive_text()) if data.get("type")=="chat": async for ch in call_provider(*MODEL_MAP["qwen3-32b"],data["messages"],stream=True): await ws.send_text(json.dumps(ch)) except WebSocketDisconnect: mgr.conns.pop(cid,None) # ───────────────────── ROOT ───────────────────── @app.get("/") def root(): return {"name":"Ultimate LLM Engine","version":"4.0"} ``` ## frontend.html ```html Ultimate LLM Frontend
